from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionSAAR(BaseModel):
    """SAAR data for starts and completions extracted from a single report for a specific month."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month covered by the data, e.g., '2022-08'")
    starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total housing starts")
    completions_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total housing completions")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report containing this data was released, used for precedence rules")
    report_document_id: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the document source (e.g., Document 1)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_saar_records: list[MonthlyConstructionSAAR]
